dimension_description: Volume tracks three-dimensional extent under explicit geometric assumptions. Many values here are derived from a stated radius, diameter, or envelope shape rather than directly measured container capacity. Each item therefore includes a short qualifier describing whether it is a literal volume, an effective occupied volume, or an approximate geometric envelope.
